name: Feline Friendship
blurb: Innate: Periodically,  Yuumi's next  basic attack or  ability hit against enemy champions will  heal her. If she is  attached to an ally within a short time, they are healed as well.

effects.description: Innate: Periodically, Yuumi's next basic attack against an enemy champion is empowered to have an uncancellable windup, gain 50 bonus range and become non-projectile. Upon hitting them with the basic attack or Prowling Projectile, or upon a Final Chapter hit on ally champions while attached, the buff is consumed to heal her for 20 - 120.59 (based on level) (+ 30% AP). If she is attached to an ally or does so within 4 seconds, they are healed for the same amount.

Innate: While attached to an ally, Yuumi grants them 2 permanent Friendship stacks whenever they kill enemy champions or minions. The ally with the highest Friendship stacks becomes Yuumi's Best Friend, which empowers her abilities with additional effects while she is attached to them.

notes:
Feline Friendship will not be consumed if Yuumi isn't missing health, except when triggered by a basic attack. While  attached, it won't be consumed if both Yuumi and her anchor aren't missing health.
Enemy hits with  Final Chapter won't trigger Feline Friendship.(unexpected)
Ability hit against enemy champions while detached can only heal Yuumi.(unexpected)
Feline Friendship will apply to a basic attack already in flight.
If there are multiple allies who have equal Friendship stacks, the one Yuumi is currently attached to becomes her Best Friend.
PENDING FOR TEST: Empowered attack interaction with parrying effects ( dodge,  block).
If Yuumi is  blinded, Feline Friendship won't be consumed.
PENDING FOR TEST: does Yuumi generate more friendship stacks from champion kills?
